title: actaea xanthorhiza
intro: Actaea xanthorhiza, commonly known as black cohosh, is a perennial plant native to North America. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with known health benefits including relief from menopausal symptoms such as hot flashes and night sweats, as well as anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of black cohosh include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, while also exhibiting estrogen-modulating properties. The bioactive constituents of black cohosh include triterpene glycosides, phenolic acids, and isoflavones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
